paths.decision: Append only the new reconciliation/component conditions section. Preserve integrated W3 exact subtotal, source/replay and scope documentation.

Selective source recovery: optional reconciliation service/http wiring; own consumed-port type correction; W4-P2 HTTP request snapshot and authority digest before first await, with egress fence. No runtime authority bypass or source projector fabrication.

Selective source recovery after independent W4-P1 finding: preserve original reconciliation semantics and add an ingress kind/binding digest with synchronous stability checks after closing awaits, including final revalidation. Initial source was exact; the final candidate intentionally differs. Then fix W4-R3: validate source and command revisions independently and correlate source with target.version; preserve original P1 authority fences.

Recover exact source blob: C08 source evidence checks no longer recurse into full case/rule/interval authority. Rule/case/interval checks remain in real proof/binding producers; current source and statement access checked before/after.
Retain W3 file exactly. Do not split loop cases or expand aggregated timeout budgets; original positives and negatives remain selected.

Selective recovery: cold persistent read is first operation on the recreated service; keep direct verifier positive and revoked negative afterward. Retain retry/idempotency/no-new-C08 checks for every training state and all three samples. Add omitted-training to the existing bundled/confirmed loop under its same 300000ms budget. Retain the source-only choice-history and unpriced/FX tests and original budgets. Reject upstream conditional-only retry removal and test splitting.

Recover exact source blob as new scope. Real Planner quote command/calculations, C08 persistence and WP11 recordChoice establish 45000 to 70000 and 235000; historical selection, source issuer and admission remain explicitly controlled seams. New 300000ms witness is recorded separately; no W3 test replaced. Later 44ecc delta adds selectable-combination guard and explicit no-prepared-change/no-receipt invariant before case projection; retained all prior assertions.

Selective recovery: retain all seven controlled upstream unit witnesses and add three discriminating ingress/final-await tests for W4-P1/P2 through the real core and createPortfolioProduct.http.reconcile. Unused unrelated ports throw; fixture admission remains explicitly controlled. Add independent-clock positive and invalid/mismatched-clock negatives for W4-R3; all original ten cases remain.

Retain W3 file and inherited runner timeout exactly. Do not split into 3 x 120000ms; all original unit/HTTP/replay/cross-case discriminants remain. Fix its reported projector mismatch at the own product capability interface, not with a fake projector.

Add source witness exactly. Domain commands/reviews, SQLite rollback, receipt binding and replay are real. Scenario composition, coverage and admission are controlled. Does not replace previous C08 or restart proofs.

Selectively recover only operationSources/operationPlanner canonical admission separation; not tracing, timeouts or source setup. Keep second policy seeded before C10, current-source callbacks, canonical operation verifier and scenario inputs; all calculation/comparison/rule/coverage/replay paths stay enriched.

reviewCorrections.disposition: P1/P2 were resolved at the first listed candidate stage; their ingress and final-await fences remain unchanged in the later R3 correction. R3 independent-clock correction reinspected statically on its listed final blobs. No runtime PASS.

findings.problem: Final awaited revalidate could validate admitted authority, mutate the borrowed kind/binding and return true; a projection was then returned without a synchronous ingress-authority fence.
findings.change: Capture digest of {kind,binding} before first await; compare after admission/closing awaits and synchronously after the final host revalidation. The actual context/lease is not cloned.
findings.witness: reconciliation refuses authority mutation after the final successful revalidation
findings.counterexample: Positive control measures final revalidation count. Fresh trials mutate principalRef, accessRevision or kind only at that call after validation; injected=true and equal final call count are required, with non-ok result and no value.

findings.problem: http.reconcile passed the borrowed original request to the core only after await authorized, permitting A to B selection replacement within the same authorized case.
findings.change: Capture request and authority digest synchronously at HTTP ingress. Authorize/invoke using the request snapshot, check ingress authority after authorization and after the core result.
findings.witness: HTTP reconciliation preserves the admitted selection when authorization mutates the caller request
findings.counterexample: Independent positive controls admit A and B. The first caseFor callback changes all three caller selection IDs from A to B; injection is required and the real HTTP entry must still return original A.
findings.additionalWitness: HTTP reconciliation fences authority from ingress before the core captures it
findings.additionalCounterexample: A positive accepts an already-current access-next revision; the negative injects that revision during first authorization and requires denial without projection.

reviewCorrections.scope: Only these un-published W4 paths and W4 metadata changed. Original seven unit controls retained; unrelated HTTP factory ports throw on use in the controlled entry-boundary fixture. No financial or installed-host proof inferred.

subsequentCorrections.problem: Reconciliation equated independent source evidence revision and domain-command CAS, rejecting legitimate source 3/4 with CAS 0/1 and correlating components using the wrong clock.
subsequentCorrections.change: Validate both numbers independently as nonnegative safe integers. Match component source revision to change.target.version; retain expectedVersion unchanged for the domain command.
subsequentCorrections.witness: reconciliation retains independent evidence and command revisions while binding effects and receipts
subsequentCorrections.counterexamples: Positive source 3/4, CAS 0/1, receipt 1/2 remains bound and stable through partial/completed observations. Source 0 matching CAS 0 does not bind original source 3. Negative, fractional or unsafe numbers in either clock are refused. All prior P1/P2 controls remain.
